full_page.content:
1946, November 1
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
POSTCARD
"O all you works of the Lord! bless the Lord. ... " November 1st-All Saints. 1946.
God bless you Miss Alice O'Brien -- you and yours. Many thanks too for your kind favor of Oct. 6th -- duely received and noted.
Yes I quited enjoyed the short visit with the five guests over night, etc. ... Indeed I did know your Mother Anna -- almost like a sister. I stopped several weeks while learning to run the trolly cars in 1887 with our Aunt Mary and Uncle Pat and of course. She was (I think) a few years older than I but we were quite friends: -- also when I started working in the State's Prison- - Uncle Pat one of the guards. ... When you write to Joe, tell him. Best Regards and God's blessing from Fr. Sol. I think I owe him a letter or two: but my big problem is my correspondence. So please pray that be able to speed up. --- Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(Also this message on a Seraphic Mass Association card : )
Miss Alice O'Brien - For God's holy grace and guidance. Nov. 1 - All Saints - 1946 God bless you Miss O'B. Pl. pray for poor sinners and don't forget Fr. Solanus
Original in possession of : Alice O'Brien 320 No. Second St. Stillwater, Minn. 55082
